claim: For static education sites with video paywall: use .lesson-video CSS class for gating placeholder and .lesson-video-player for the iframe wrapper — keep gating logic in a single gating.js file

decisions.notes: Pattern proven on 148-page bilingual site; single gating.js with language detection handles both RU (free after login) and EN (subscription required)

rationale: Pattern proven on 148-page bilingual site; single gating.js with language detection handles both RU (free after login) and EN (subscription required)
